# ML model files are stored here.
# These files are generated by the training notebook and loaded by the backend on startup.
#
# Expected files:
#   - tfidf_vectorizer.pkl  (TF-IDF vectorizer, trained on LIAR dataset)
#   - lr_model.pkl          (Logistic Regression classifier)
#
# These .pkl files are ignored by .gitignore due to size.
# To generate them, run the training notebook: /notebooks/train_lr_model.ipynb
